rationale: Adds a new opt-in room CO2 metric and editable source selection to the main plan and kiosk, absent from v1.81.0. Static cards, temperature fills and device badges are unchanged.

summary.ru: CO₂ в комнатах: среднее или выбранный датчик, с предпросмотром и подсказкой.
summary.en: Room CO2 readings: automatic average or a selected sensor, with preview and tooltip.
